title: Does Personalization Break Trust? Open-Set Rejection Calibration Under Few-Shot On-Device Intent Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Always-on virtual assistants increasingly personalize on-device to new user-specific commands via few-shot fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), but this adaptation is evaluated almost exclusively on whether it learns the new commands, not on whether the assistant can still recognize an input that matches none of its intents - the out-of-scope (OOS) rejection problem. We show that naive few-shot LoRA personalization degrades OOS-rejection AUROC (area under the ROC curve) on every one of five public intent-classification benchmarks (mean drop $0.055$--$0.258$, five seeds each), while in-scope accuracy is preserved. A scorer-invariant check shows part of this drop is an artifact of the standard confidence scorer's own miscalibration under adaptation, though a smaller, genuine effect remains under any scorer; we trace it to a measurable shrinkage of the embedding margin around known-intent regions (pooled Spearman rho=0.61$). translated_title: 个性化会破坏信任吗？少样本端侧意图自适应下的开放集拒识校准
translated_abstract: 常驻虚拟助手越来越多地通过少样本微调（如 LoRA）在设备端针对新的用户特定命令进行个性化，但这种自适应的评估几乎只关注其是否学会了新命令，而忽视了助手是否仍能识别出与任何意图都不匹配的输入——即范围外（OOS）拒识问题。我们证明，朴素的少样本 LoRA 个性化会在全部五个公开意图分类基准上降低 OOS 拒识 AUROC（ROC 曲线下面积）（平均下降 0.055–0.258，每个基准五个随机种子），同时范围内准确率得以保持。一项不依赖于打分器的检查表明，这一下降部分是标准置信度打分器在自适应过程中自身校准失准所产生的伪象，但在任何打分器下仍存在一个较小的真实效应；我们将其追溯到已知意图区域附近嵌入边距的可测量收缩（合并 Spearman rho=0.61）。一种部署成本低廉的修复方法是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现少样本 LoRA 个性化微调会损害端侧虚拟助手对范围外输入的拒识能力（AUROC 下降），其部分源于置信度打分器校准失准的伪象，其余真实效应则来自已知意图区域附近嵌入边距的收缩，并提出了一种部署成本低廉的修复方法。
en_tdlr: Few-shot LoRA personalization degrades out-of-scope rejection performance (AUROC) in on-device virtual assistants, an effect partly caused by confidence scorer miscalibration and partly by a genuine shrinkage of embedding margins around known intents, for which the authors propose a deployment-cheap fix.
